reconstruction_summary: Re-ran V2 (Linear single-track with prior C_alpha + per-segment yaw-gyro bias subtracted on straight-line samples) by importing triage.linear_st_yaw_rate and parameters.PARAM_BY_PLATFORM from the agent's folder.
notes: V2 is the shipped best variant per REPORT.md ("V2 (Linear single-track with prior Cα + yaw-gyro bias) is the shipped best variant"). Per-segment yaw-bias uses straight-line samples (|delta|<0.01) on each sim.csv, matching the per-__source__ logic in tools/run_ladder.py:yaw_bias. Parameters come from the agent's parameters.PARAM_BY_PLATFORM with per-platform Mach-E and F-150 values, applied to their respective canonical Ford segments. Baseline_rmse_recomputed matches the precomputed canonical V0 to ~1e-6.
